primary_comparison: held-out recurrence prediction from STA profile versus endpoint accuracy, model confidence, model size, immediate retry success, retrieval rate, and generic judge score
exclusion_policy: Exclude only transport failures and malformed outputs after two parser retries; retain substantive refusals, uncertainty and timeouts as behavioral outcomes.
blinding: Model adapters do not receive oracle rules or expected decisions except in designated correction-artifact conditions. Analysis labels remain sealed until traces are immutable.
